# A prospecting cadence for every lead on your list, checked before you send

> Free sales cadence builder and outreach sequence planner. Paste your prospect list and get a multi-channel cadence (email, phone call with voicemail script, LinkedIn note, mailed letter) on business days, call times inside each prospect's local business hours, suppression and consent checks, and a CSV and calendar file. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
